general-1: Sure thing! I would love to help. How many bedrooms are you thinking?
Absolutely! I know some very quiet spots near the beach. Tell me your bedrooms and budget, and I will shortlist the best ones for you.
general-2: No worries, lots of people do that! The visa is the part to check.
Good news: staying part of the year is common. Let me walk you through the visa options, and I can introduce a trusted lawyer if you would like.
general-3: A village feels social and safe. A villa feels like your own world.
If you like a community feel with security, a village suits you. If privacy matters most, a villa is better. Which sounds more like you?
general-4: Sure! I will send you three good ones tomorrow.
Yes, and I will choose three that fit what you told me. I will message you tomorrow, and we can book visits for this week.
home-1: Yep, all the appliances stay with the house!
Yes, the fridge, oven and cooktop all stay. If you like, I can list every item so you know exactly what you get.
home-2: Three bedrooms, and each has its own air conditioner!
Three bedrooms, each with its own air conditioner. Shall we start with the master bedroom? It is my favorite room.
home-3: Yes, the pressure is great, and every bathroom has hot water!
Yes, the pressure is strong thanks to the pump tank, and each bathroom has hot water. I can turn on the taps so you can feel it.
home-4: Around two thousand baht a month, not too bad!
The owner paid around two thousand baht a month. If you use less air conditioning, it will be even lower, and I can show you the past bills.
around-1: Yes, it is all yours, and about one point five meters deep!
Yes, it is a private pool, about one point five meters deep. It is perfect for a family, and I can arrange a cleaning service too.
around-2: About two hundred square meters, and we can send a gardener!
The garden is about two hundred square meters. A weekly gardener is easy to arrange, and I will get you a price.
around-3: Very safe! There is a guard at the gate all night.
Very safe. The gate has a guard around the clock, and I can introduce you to the village office so you can ask about security yourself.
around-4: Supermarket in ten minutes, hospital in fifteen. Very convenient!
The supermarket is ten minutes away and the hospital is fifteen. I can drive you along both routes during the viewing.
deal-1: I hear you! What number would feel right for you?
I understand, and I want to find a price that works. Tell me your number, and I will see what I can do with the owner.
deal-2: Cash helps! Let me talk to the owner for you.
Cash is a strong offer. I cannot promise, but I will present it to the owner today and push for the best discount.
deal-3: I will do my best to get the furniture included!
That is a fair idea. I will ask the owner to include the furniture with the discount and call you this evening with an answer.
deal-4: Fast! We can sign the reservation this week.
We can sign the reservation this week and transfer in about thirty days. I can prepare the documents now so we are ready.
terms-1: Not the land itself, but there are safe ways to do it!
You cannot own the land directly, but a long-term lease or owning the house separately works well. I can introduce a lawyer to explain.
terms-2: One hundred thousand baht, and the refund rules are in the contract.
The deposit is one hundred thousand baht. Refund terms are in the contract, so let us read them together before you decide.
terms-3: We split the transfer fee, and the seller pays the taxes.
Normally we split the transfer fee equally and the seller pays the taxes. It is negotiable, and I can ask for a better split for you.
terms-4: Yes, we can pay in installments as it gets built!
Yes, installments that follow construction progress are possible. I will write the schedule down so you can see every payment date.
viewing-1: Saturday morning works! What time would be good?
Saturday morning is perfect. Tell me your time, and I will make sure the owner and the house are ready for you.
viewing-2: Meet me at the gate. I will send you the map!
I will wait for you at the front gate. I will send the map and my Line contact, so call me if you get lost.
viewing-3: Photos are fine! I will just check with the owner.
Yes, you can take photos and videos. If the owner is at home, I will ask first, so you can film freely and take your time.
viewing-4: Just tell me your offer, and I will take it to the owner!
Tell me your offer, and I will present it to the owner right away. If they agree, we can prepare the reservation agreement together.
